evidence_slice: Barking and Dagenham Council's Dagenham Heathway SPD page states that the SPD was adopted on 16 June 2026 and provides supplementary guidance to Local Plan Policy SPP6 for the Dagenham Heathway SPD Area. The Council's FAQ states capacity for over 1,000 new homes in the Dagenham Heathway Transformation Area, predominantly at Dagenham Heathway Mall (up to 860) and Dagenham Heathway Station (up to 178).
